codeCheck.entityImpact: The field read will return null and the script may fail.
codeCheck.columnQuestion: Confirm whether {name} is a view/subgrid column or a form field.

codeCheck.columnImpact: A missing column returns null, leaving a blank cell without throwing.
codeCheck.guessQuestion: Confirm whether {name} in {env} is a field, column, or another key.
codeCheck.guessEvidence: The changed line uses a publisher-prefixed bracket key; static analysis cannot distinguish metadata from an ordinary object key.
codeCheck.guessHow: Inspect the object in context; for a form field use getAttribute so later checks can resolve it.
codeCheck.guessImpact: A missed classification may hide a real missing field.
codeCheck.entityReadQuestion: Could not read the table list for {env}; confirm whether {names} exists.
codeCheck.entityReadEvidence: EntityDefinitions could not be read (permissions or timeout), so these tables were not marked missing.
codeCheck.entityReadHow: Grant metadata-read permission and rerun, or verify the logical names in the environment.

codeCheck.entityMissing: Changed code calls Xrm.WebApi for {name}, but that entity does not exist in {env}.
codeCheck.guidQuestion: Confirm whether {guid} refers to the same record in {env}.
codeCheck.guidEvidence: A hard-coded GUID cannot be associated with a table by static analysis.
codeCheck.guidHow: Find its use in source (configuration record, team, queue, or view), then verify it by table in the target.
codeCheck.guidImpact: If the record is absent, runtime returns empty or throws.
codeCheck.optionQuestion: Confirm these option values exist in the target option set in {env}.
codeCheck.optionEvidence: The code compares numbers with option values; static analysis cannot reliably identify the field.
codeCheck.optionHow: Trace the comparison to its field and inspect that option set in the target environment.
codeCheck.optionImpact: A missing value leaves the branch unreachable and silently disables behavior.

csharp.filterHow: Grant metadata-read permission or inspect the table fields in the environment, then rerun this tool.
csharp.filterImpact: A missing filtering attribute prevents expected triggering, but this run cannot assert absence.

csharp.secureQuestion: Confirm the plug-in step secure configuration in {env} matches this code.

migration.verdict.inconclusive: Inconclusive: {unresolved} components could not be verified; {missing} target components are missing and {shadowed} solution layers will be shadowed.
migration.verdict.safe: No data-loss risk was found; {missing} target components are missing and {shadowed} solution layers will be shadowed.
migration.recommendation.critical: Resolve critical issues before release: merge changes into a managed solution or add the missing values in the target first.
migration.recommendation.unresolved: Verify component type/name mappings and retry failed probes before judging whether release is safe.
migration.recommendation.shadowed: If shadowing is unacceptable, merge the changes into an existing managed solution in the target and import them with its upgrade.
